expected.subject: Sophie, quick note from Legora
expected.body:
Hi Sophie,

I wanted to reach out as Legora has evolved a lot since you first came across us.

Firms like BAHR are already using Legora to cut contract review time by around 60%.

We run a live demo webinar each week — save a seat here: [WEBINAR_LINK].

William
Legora

notes: 4-lawyer UK chambers from late-2024 backlog. SMB webinar CTA, soft re-engagement tone.
